rationale: The search command fully satisfies the requested literal, case-insensitive title and description matching, optional status filtering, stable ordering, empty text output, and banner-free JSON. Deterministic checks and fixture tests cover title and description matches, literal metacharacters, filtering, errors, empty arrays, help, and banner constraints. The implementation is idiomatic and concise; the main minor issue is that the filtering pipeline is embedded directly in the command rather than factored for reuse or isolated testing. Integration follows existing output and help conventions and changes the JSON helper only as needed for an empty collection. The banner is immediately recognizable as a search console, makes FIND TASKS the focal point, and explains the search dimensions. Its balanced frame and whitespace are clean, though the design is straightforward rather than exceptional. The diff is tightly scoped.
